verdict.rationale: Publishing operating hours, daily limits and session timeouts up front is a fair question for a government online filing service, so the axis applies. The pack has no published maintenance window, per-day transaction limit or session-timeout disclosure for Online Services or Web File. The only related wording is the marketing phrase "anytime, anywhere" (ny-dtf-docs-1), which is not a disclosure of service windows or limits, and the e-services surface itself was not fetched because robots.txt disallows it.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
